instruction: On Sheet2, present monthly sales totals by aggregating the revenue for each month.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating Sheet2 with monthly revenue summary. Verified with Python script processing all 2000 rows: May=21621.46, Jun=58383.01, Jul=23868.94, Aug=52175.72, Sep=21790.02. Custom getter extracts month totals from Sheet2, custom metric compares against expected values with 0.01 tolerance.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: monthly revenue totals match expected values (May=21621.46, Jun=58383.01, Jul=23868.94, Aug=52175.72, Sep=21790.02)
Expected values were properly verified from actual data (Python script processing all 2000 rows)
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('month_totals', {}) which is correct since get_rule() returns config['rules']
Postconfig appropriately saves the file before getter reads it
Partial credit logic is sound - scores each month independently
Tolerance of 0.01 is appropriate for financial data
Getter checks for Sheet2 existence before reading

LIMITATION: Getter assumes rigid data format - headers in row 1, values in row 2 (horizontal layout). Will fail if user creates valid summary in vertical format (rows of Month|Total) or other reasonable layouts
MINOR: Instruction says 'displaying' total revenue but evaluator only verifies numeric correctness, not presentation quality or visibility
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Make getter more flexible to handle multiple valid layouts: (1) horizontal format (current), (2) vertical format with Month column and Total column, (3) check multiple rows, not just row 2
Consider adding basic presentation checks: verify Sheet2 is visible/not hidden, check that data cells have reasonable formatting
Add getter logic to search for month names in any cells, not just row 1, to be more robust to layout variations
